CmdhBuffer.label: CmdhBuffer
CmdhBuffer.description: This Object defines limits in usage of buffers for temporarily storing information that needs to be forwarded to other CSEs during processing of CMDH-related requests in a CSE.

ApplicableEventCategory.label: ApplicableEventCategory
ApplicableEventCategory.description: Contains a list of event category values

MaxBufferSize.label: MaxBufferSize
MaxBufferSize.description: Contains the max Buffer size of the CmdhBuffer Object Instance

StoragePriority.label: StoragePriority
StoragePriority.description:
Storage priority for the buffered data associated to that CmdhBuffer Object Instance. t 
Buffered requests associated with a lower storage priority shall be purged before buffered requests with a higher storage priority.
